assumptions.statement: Official precise redlines are not yet available in the repository; site_boundary.geojson and key_areas.geojson are derived from brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson with official_boundary=false, geometry_role=provisional_constraint, boundary_precision=provisional_rough.
assumptions.impact: All areas, ratios, and geometry are for design self-consistency and visualization only; they must not be used as official redline, approval basis, or precise area basis, and must be recalculated when official polygons are released.

assumptions.statement: Every area-based metric (site area, green ratio, public-space ratio, phasing areas, building footprint) is recomputed from the submitted provisional geometry in EPSG:4548; conversion and rounding tolerance is applied per metric.
assumptions.impact: Metric values in metrics.json are reproducible from geometry but are concept values; official attachments supersede them and require recalculation via depth:metrics_recalculation.

assumptions.statement: Statutory regulatory controls (floor area ratio, building height, building density, official green ratio, setbacks, road redlines) are missing from the cleared material; they are declared unknown in metrics.json instead of fabricated.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Concept floor area uses a working average of 3.0 storeys (concept_floor_area_sqm = building_footprint_area_sqm * 3.0); building types are concept classifications (ai_r_and_d, incubator, office, mixed_use, education, residential, talent_apartment, retail, cultural, mobility_hub).
assumptions.impact: Building scale is a design hypothesis, not a regulatory or approval figure; no statutory intensity conclusion is implied.

assumptions.statement: All road centerlines in roads.geojson are concept schematic alignments (road_network_length_m ~39,996 m), not road redlines; engineering alignment, cross-sections, and bridge/tunnel conclusions are out of scope.
assumptions.impact: Road geometry supports concept connectivity and slow-mobility analysis only.

assumptions.statement: Green space and public space are concept networks (one pulse, two rivers, multiple nodes; six plazas); green_ratio 0.218605 and public_space_ratio 0.051192 are concept recalculation ratios, not official green ratios.
assumptions.impact: Ratios are internally consistent with the submitted geometry but not statutory indicators.

assumptions.statement: The three key areas (Zhongzhiyuan, Beijing AI Origin Community, Dazhongsi) are provisional rough polygons inside the site boundary without overlap; their areas are concept values.
assumptions.impact: Detailed design conclusions remain directional until official key-area polygons are published.

assumptions.statement: Phasing (P1 2026-2028, P2 2029-2032, P3 2033-2037) is a concept organization of renewal lines, not a government commitment; renewal projects require ownership, heritage, regulatory, and engineering feasibility checks.
assumptions.impact: Phasing areas support scenario planning only; policy and funding arrangements are not commitments.

assumptions.statement: Municipal pipelines, fire protection, flood control/drainage, sponge-city conditions, and engineering constraints are missing; the package provides system-level recommendations and a to-be-supplemented checklist only.
assumptions.impact: Utility and engineering conclusions cannot be drawn; professional confirmation is required before implementation use.

assumptions.statement: Drawings (A3 booklet, A0 boards) and the visual index are generated from the same submitted geometry/metrics; figure and drawing versions follow manifest hashes and must be regenerated together with any geometry change.
assumptions.impact: Reviewers should treat drawings as derived presentation artifacts; JSON/GeoJSON remain authoritative.
